children: Shares of Viant Technology declined post market after the company said one of its stockholders would offer 8.5 million shares in an underwritten public offering.
The stock was down 11% to $10.98 after Wednesday's closing bell, and ended the market session off by 1.8% at $12.37. The stock was up 2.7% year-to-date through the close.
Viant said the underwriters will have a 30-day option to buy up to roughly 1.3 million additional shares from the company directly.
The company will receive proceeds only from additional shares sold to the underwriters, and not from shares sold by its stockholder.
